title: Lazy Mole
description: Two-day chicken mole: bagless sous vide chicken, overnight peanut butter and cocoa sauce, served over bouillon rice.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: or to the Tiger line for this amount of rice

steps.title: Season chicken
steps.text: Season {thighs} and {breasts} with {salt}. Keep thighs and breasts separate.

steps.title: Sous vide
steps.text: Place the chicken bagless on separate racks in the Anova Precision Oven with the bottom drip pan installed. Run 145°F, 100% steam, for 2 hours. Cool, then refrigerate.

steps.title: Simmer sauce
steps.text: Simmer the sauce for 20 minutes, stirring often, until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Rest overnight
steps.text: Cool the sauce and refrigerate overnight. The flavors meld and the raw spice edge disappears.

steps.title: Slice and sear
steps.text: Slice the chilled chicken into chunks. Sear in {oil} in a hot cast iron skillet for about 1 minute per side, color only. It is already cooked, so do not overdo it.

steps.title: Thicken sauce
steps.text: Reheat the sauce to a simmer. Whisk {cornstarch} into {slurrywater}, stir it in, and simmer 2 minutes. Add a little more slurry only if it does not cling.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Add the seared chicken to the sauce and simmer 3 minutes.

steps.title: Rice
steps.text: Cook {rice} with {ricewater}, {btb} and {butter} in the Tiger rice cooker.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve the mole over the rice.

notes: Starting quantities are a floor; adjust spice upward to taste. Freezes well for up to 3 months. Reheat in the APO at 325°F, 30% steam, 15 minutes, or on the stovetop with a splash of broth. Thaw frozen portions overnight in the fridge first.
